savollar.savol: If I ___ more time, I would learn another language.
savollar.izoh: Second Conditional: if + past simple, would + infinitive.

savollar.savol: The film was so boring that I ___ asleep.
savollar.izoh: 'fall asleep' — uxlab qolmoq. O'tgan zamon shakli: fell.

Aniq boshlanish nuqtasi bilan Present Perfect: since 2015.
